patches.title: Dead Hare v1.5 by Leet Sketcher
desc: Monsters already removed from battle (e.g. killed by the Scimitar's instant
kill) no longer counterattack.

patches.title: Item/Magic Counter v1.2 (Dead Hare compatible version) by Leet Sketcher
desc: Monsters that counter one specific spell or item (SrBehemoth, FlameEater...)
no longer keep countering every attack after being hit by it.
Requires dead_hare.asm first.

patches.title: Zombie/Rippler v1.2, fix A + B by Leet Sketcher
desc: Rippler no longer swaps hidden statuses (Morph, Dog Block...). A target
freed from Zombie by Rippler is healed 1/8 of its max HP (like Revivify)
instead of staying alive at 0 HP.

patches.title: Imp's Retort v1.5 by Leet Sketcher
desc: An Imp Cyan whose Retort fails no longer counters every physical attack for
the rest of the battle; Retort is cleared after every Fight.

patches.title: Self Sneeze v2.0 by Leet Sketcher
desc: The Fake Mustache control link is cut when Relm jumps with Palidor or when
either side is removed from battle.

patches.title: Dead in the Air v2.4 by Leet Sketcher
desc: A Condemned character whose timer runs out mid-Jump gets Wound instead of
staying alive at 0 HP; items are restored after every battle ending; the
Esper +30% HP/MP bonus is computed correctly.

patches.title: Smoke and Mirrors v1.0 by Leet Sketcher
desc: A Muddled character's Smoke Bomb no longer removes the monsters (which won
the battle) instead of the party.

patches.title: Soul Saved v1.4, fix A by Leet Sketcher
desc: Soul Savers are immune to instant death, so X-Zone can no longer end the
Wrexsoul battle early.

patches.title: Morph Mayhem v1.2 by Leet Sketcher
desc: The Morph gauge no longer drains while Terra is asleep, stopped or frozen,
while someone uses Quick, or after she leaves battle.

patches.title: Rock Bottom v1.3 by Leet Sketcher
desc: Near Fatal is applied again when Petrify is cured on a character under 1/8
of max HP.

patches.title: Status Unknown v1.1 by Leet Sketcher
desc: Statuses with no outline color no longer display blank and hide other
statuses such as Life 3 or Float.

patches.title: Imp Skimp v1.4 by Leet Sketcher
desc: The Imp sprite follows the Imp status instead of the Imp spell (a missed
Imp no longer turns the target, a Runic-absorbed Imp no longer flashes Celes).

patches.title: Imp's Rage v1.1 by Leet Sketcher
desc: Rage and Dance can no longer be used while the character is an Imp.

patches.title: Imp's Call v1.1 by Leet Sketcher
desc: An Esper summon cancelled by Imp no longer uses up the summon for the battle.

patches.title: Shadow's Status v1.2 by Leet Sketcher
desc: Lasting statuses (Vanish, Float...) are removed from Shadow after the
Floating Continent so he doesn't carry them to the Colosseum.

patches.title: Stone Faced v1.2 by Leet Sketcher
desc: Petrified monsters no longer repeat their last attack after every turn.

patches.title: Stone Cold v1.2 by Leet Sketcher
desc: Petrify no longer blocks Revivify's healing, so a Petrified Zombie no longer
ends up at 0 HP once Petrify is cured.

patches.title: Killer Life 3 v1.4 by Leet Sketcher
desc: An Undead monster killed by an X-weapon instant kill no longer revives with
Life 3 only to die again.

patches.title: Zombie/Tapir v1.2, fix A by Leet Sketcher
desc: Tapir curing Zombie heals 1/8 of max HP instead of leaving the character
alive at 0 HP.

patches.title: Double Block v1.1 by Leet Sketcher
desc: A living character with a shield no longer blocks a Fenix Down twice.

patches.title: Better Dice v1.3 by Leet Sketcher
desc: Setzer's Dice: one die always has an even 1-6 distribution and the others
are closer to even (vanilla rolled 1-4 at 3/16 and 5-6 at 1/8); the
matching-dice bonus also applies to the 2-die Dice; the Offering halves
Dice damage (replaces Chance Offering, which only fixed that last part).

patches.title: Half Knife v1.1 by Leet Sketcher
desc: The Offering also halves the ValiantKnife's bonus damage.

patches.title: Bye Bye Breath v1.2 by Leet Sketcher
desc: Fixes two crashes in the second Phunbaba fight (a Charmed Phunbaba blowing a
member out of a full party, and an empty party after a lone KO).

patches.title: Off Death Row v1.2 by Leet Sketcher
desc: Safety Bit and Memento Ring clear Condemned when they save the character
instead of leaving the status active.

patches.title: Throwback v1.1 by Leet Sketcher
desc: Shadow steps forward and throws normally when his target has Jumped.

patches.title: Save Point Switch v1.2 by Leet Sketcher
desc: In Phoenix Cave and Kefka's Tower, switching to a party that isn't on a
Save Point no longer lets it save or use Tents and Sleeping Bags.

patches.title: Menu Malarky v1.3 by Leet Sketcher
desc: Timing tricks with the Main Menu can no longer skip events: Locke passing
the South Figaro guard (missing Celes), Inferno and Poltergeist in Kefka's
Tower. Applied after save_point_switch.asm as the author requires.

patches.title: Returner's Day Off v1.4 by Leet Sketcher
desc: Two events account for Gau being left on the Veldt; this could leave
characters behind and freeze the game after the Esper World flashback.

patches.title: Shadow Gone v1.3 by Leet Sketcher
desc: When Shadow leaves an all-Gau party entering Narshe, the party selection
screen opens instead of leaving an empty party (forced reset).

patches.title: Game Over v1.0 by Leet Sketcher
desc: A defeat on the world map no longer leaves an event pointer on the stack
(52 defeats in a row overwrote RAM and could freeze the game).

patches.title: Map Mishap v1.8 by Leet Sketcher
desc: Fixes seven map glitches (see Leet Sketcher's readme for the list).

patches.title: Stepping Out v1.0 by Leet Sketcher
desc: Holding Y while stepping on an event tile in split-party dungeons no longer
switches parties before the event fires (skipping it).

patches.title: Unequipium v1.1 by Leet Sketcher
desc: Events that remove gear from characters outside the party now refresh their
stats, so HP/MP no longer display wrong after swapping members.

patches.title: Trigger Happy v1.0 by Leet Sketcher
desc: A timer event no longer overrides a tile event firing on the same frame
(Zone Eater's cave: skipping an exit or surviving the falling ceiling).

patches.title: Walk This Way v1.0 by Leet Sketcher
desc: Diagonal stairs run the normal per-step handling (poison damage, Tintinabar
healing); Terra no longer walks an extra tile when Zone Eater's ceiling falls.

patches.title: Multiple Events Fix v1.10 by Leet Sketcher
desc: Fixes ten events that are wrong in different ways (see Leet Sketcher's
readme for the list).

patches.title: Bland Entrance v1.2 by Leet Sketcher
desc: Fixes several problems in the opening events of the game.

patches.title: Castle Party v1.3 by Leet Sketcher
desc: Sabin's party is no longer reordered when switching back from Cyan's scenes
in Doma during the Imperial Camp infiltration.

patches.title: Narshe's Door v1.3 by Leet Sketcher
desc: Narshe's secret cave door no longer closes again after opening the Main
Menu in the World of Ruin.

patches.title: Anonymous Attack v1.3 by Leet Sketcher
desc: Kefka's special attack during the Sealed Gate stall is loaded at battle
start (it always missed and showed a blank name).

patches.title: Caravaggio v1.3 by Leet Sketcher
desc: Roulette used through Sketch or Rage shows its targeting pointer and can
target the whole field again.

patches.title: Chain of Command v1.3 by Leet Sketcher
desc: Gogo's command names changed by relics (Slot -> GP Rain...) also show in
his Status menu command selection.

patches.title: Shadow Copy v1.1 by Leet Sketcher
desc: Gogo's Mimic can no longer copy Shadow's actions when Shadow is fought in
the Dragon's Neck Colosseum.

patches.title: Precious Jewels v1.0 by Leet Sketcher
desc: Standing next to the Gem Box at the top of the Fanatics' Tower without
taking it no longer triggers the cultists' ambush.

patches.title: Phoenix Chest v1.3 by Leet Sketcher
desc: The Phoenix Cave chest Locke opened no longer closes again for good.

patches.title: Off the Hook v1.3 by Leet Sketcher
desc: A party member can no longer end up above the hook near the Phoenix Cave
entrance.

patches.title: Loud Music v1.0 by Leet Sketcher
desc: The Opera House organ is muffled in the lobby as intended; removes a Kefka's
Tower trigger that grabs a hook that isn't there.
